title: senecio humifusus
intro: Senecio humifusus, commonly known as Dusty Miller, is a succulent plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, characterized by its silvery-gray leaves and ability to thrive in dry conditions. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving coughs, and treating various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Senecio humifusus can be attributed to its anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antiseptic properties, which help in soothing respiratory issues and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
